MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORDSMAN_DEFEND.title: Defend
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BROKEN_BLADE.title: Broken Blade
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BROKEN_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_SWAP.title: Sword Swap
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_SWAP.description:
Choose one of your swords to become your [gold]current sword[/gold]. If it has not come out yet, summon it.{IfUpgraded:show:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].|}
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_TOKEN.title: Gram
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_TOKEN.description: Current sword: Attacks deal additional damage equal to its upgrade level.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_TOKEN.title: Ganjiang
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_TOKEN.descriptio: Current sword: Attacks deal more damage. Paired with Moye.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_TOKEN.title: Moye
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_TOKEN.description: Current sword: Gain more [gold]Block[/gold]. Paired with Ganjiang.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_TOKEN.title: Kusanagi
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_TOKEN.descriptio:
Current sword: Inherits half of the previous sword's effect.
Cost: Lose a little HP at the end of a combat in which it was summoned. You can switch to it only twice per combat.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_TOKEN.title: Tyrfing
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_TOKEN.description:
Current sword: Attacks ignore [gold]Block[/gold].
Cost: From level 3, gain an unremovable curse each of the first 3 times you use it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_TOKEN.title: Dáinsleif
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_TOKEN.descripti:
Current sword: Played cards that cost 1 or more return to your draw pile instead of the discard pile.
Cost: You cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold] while it is your current sword.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_TOKEN.title: Durandal
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DURANDAL_TOKEN.descriptio:
Current sword: Reduces attack damage you take.
Cost: You cannot switch to it at 30% HP or less.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_TOKEN.title: Sköfnung
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKOFNUNG_TOKEN.descriptio:
Current sword: Attacks inflict [gold]Scars[/gold].
Cost: Cannot be used on the first turn of combat.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_TOKEN.title: Onimaru
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ONIMARU_TOKEN.description:
Emerges on its own at the start of combat and attacks automatically every turn.
Cost: In normal combats, it sometimes attacks with a random kind.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CLAIOMH_SOLAIS_TOKEN.desc:
Current sword: At the end of your turn, charge 1 [gold]Light[/gold].
Cost: If you end your turn holding another sword, all Light fades.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_TOKEN.title: Caladbolg
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_TOKEN.descripti:
Current sword: Attacks hit up to 3 enemies.
Cost: Attacks deal less damage when there is only one enemy.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FORGE_SAFE_TOKEN.title: Safe Upgrade
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FORGE_SAFE_TOKEN.descript: Raise the upgrade level by {Gain}. Always succeeds.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FORGE_GAMBLE2_TOKEN.title: Gamble Upgrade +2
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FORGE_GAMBLE3_TOKEN.title: Gamble Upgrade +3
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FORGE_RESULT_TOKEN.title: Upgrade Result
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FORGE_RESULT_TOKEN.SHATTE: [gold]{SwordName}[/gold] shattered. Its cards are stored in the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_BRANSTOCK_DRAW.title: Branstock's Blade
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_BRANSTOCK_DRAW.descr:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Gain {Vigor} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Vigor every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_TWO_SHARDS.title: Shard Rend
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_TWO_SHARDS.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per hit from level 4).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_FLEECE_CUTTER.title: Fleece Cutter
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_FLEECE_CUTTER.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Combo[/gold]: Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_ANVIL_SPLITTER.title: Guardbreaker
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_ANVIL_SPLITTER.descr:
Remove all of the target's [gold]Block[/gold], then deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Vuln} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level, 2 Vulnerable from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_REFORGED.title: Reforge
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_REFORGED.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put a [gold]Gram[/gold] Attack card of your choice from your discard pile into your hand.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).

MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_REGINS_REFORGING.des:
This combat, [gold]Gram[/gold] counts as {Levels} {Levels:plural:level|levels} higher (max 5).
Draw 1 card for each level that could not be gained above 5.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 0 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_FAFNIR_SLAYER.title: Dragonslayer
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GRAM_FAFNIR_SLAYER.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deals {EliteBonus} more against Elites and Bosses.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: If this kills the target, raise your Max HP by {MaxHp}.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).

This combat, your attacks deal (Gram level + 1) = {Bonus} additional damage, whatever your current sword is.
While Gram is current, this replaces Gram's own effect.
[gold]Gram[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 1 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_SLASH.title: Yang Slash
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_SLASH.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Pair[/gold]: +{PairDamage} damage.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_GUARD.title: Yin Ward
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_GUARD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Pair[/gold]: Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_ASSASSIN.title: Ambush
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_ASSASSIN.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times.
[gold]Pair[/gold]: Hit {PairHits} more {PairHits:plural:time|times}.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per hit every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_HAIR_AND_NAILS.title: Hair and Nails
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_HAIR_AND_NAILS.descr:
Lose {HpLoss} HP and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Pair[/gold]: Do not lose HP.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_BELLOWS.title: Bellows
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYE_BELLOWS.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Pair[/gold]: Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_SWORD_DANCE.title: Twin Dance
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_SWORD_DANCE.descript:
[gold]Twin Swords[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Pair[/gold] (always): Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per hit every 2 levels, +1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_HIDDEN_BLADE.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Each time this is [gold]Retained[/gold] through the end of a turn, it deals {RetainBonus} more damage this combat.
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_SACRIFICE.title: Moye's Sacrifice
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_SACRIFICE.descripti:
Lose {HpLoss} HP.
This combat, whenever a [gold]Pair[/gold] effect triggers, gain {PairBlock} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-GANJIANG_CHIS_VENGEANCE.d:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, +2 for every 4 HP you lost this combat (max +16, now +{Vengeance}).
[gold]Pair[/gold]: Apply {PairVuln} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
[gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_MATED_PAIR.title: Perfect Pair
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TWIN_MATED_PAIR.descripti:
[gold]Twin Swords[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

MAGICSWORDSMAN-ODINS_BROKEN_BLADE.title: Blade Broken by Odin
MAGICSWORDSMAN-ODINS_BROKEN_BLADE.descri: While this is in your hand, your attacks deal {Penalty} less damage.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FURNACE_OFFERING.title: Furnace Offering
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FURNACE_OFFERING.descript: At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, take {HpLoss} damage.

MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_GATHERING_CLOUDS:

[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Status and Curse cards in your hand. Draw 1 card for each.
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 Block per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_OROCHIS_TAIL.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Choose a Status or Curse card in your draw or discard pile and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).

MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_MAGATAMA.descrip:
Reduce one of your debuffs by 1.
Draw {Cards} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (1 more card from level 5).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-KUSANAGI_EIGHT_HEADS.desc:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Hits} times.
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per hit every 2 levels).

If [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] is inheriting another sword's effect, put a card of that sword from your draw pile into your hand. It costs 1 less this turn.

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
+{PerCard} damage for each Status or Curse card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this combat.
[gold]Kusanagi[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per level).

MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_FLAME_BLADE.title: Flame Slash

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

[gold]Tyrfing[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+2 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_BERSERKER_ARNGRIM:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times.
If you lost HP this turn, hit 1 more time.
[gold]Tyrfing[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage per hit every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_ALWAYS_VICTORIOUS:

[gold]Tyrfing[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+3 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TYRFING_DWARVEN_CURSE.des:
This combat, whenever a Curse card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain {TyrfingDwarvenCursePower} [gold]Strength[/gold].

MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_LEGACY.title: Dáinn's Legacy

Of the cards [gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] returns, the first {TopCards} each turn go on top of your draw pile (except 0-cost cards).

[gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (costs 1 from level 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-DAINSLEIF_NEVER_MISSES.de:
Whenever [gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] returns a card to your draw pile, deal {Hit} damage to a random enemy.
[gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] level {SwordLevel} (+1 damage every 2 levels).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TENMUS_ILLNESS.title: Tenmu's Illness
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TENMUS_ILLNESS.descriptio: At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, apply {Amount} [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Frail[/gold] or [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] (random) to yourself.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HEIDREKS_END.title: Heidrek's End
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HEIDREKS_END.description: When you draw this card, take {HpLoss} damage.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-IRRECONCILABLE_CURSE.desc: At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, it is put into your draw pile at a random position instead of being discarded.
